configurePresets.name: rel
configurePresets.displayName: rel  - RelWithDebInfo (the only valid configuration for performance measurement)
configurePresets.description: Optimized, with debug symbols. Every performance number quoted in documentation must originate from this configuration.

configurePresets.name: dbg
configurePresets.description: Keeps assert() active for stepping through code. Not for performance measurement.

configurePresets.name: san
configurePresets.description: Detects out-of-bounds access, use-after-free, leaks and undefined behavior. Several times slower than rel; must not be used for timing.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Required once concurrent search is implemented. TSan is unavailable on MinGW/Windows; use it on Linux and in CI only.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: CI only. Any compiler warning fails the pipeline.
